posts.text: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times. And the standards framework we’ve proposed supports responsible deployment of both open and proprietary models.

quotedTweet.text:
For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter.

AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country.

Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.

The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models.

https://t.co/AUKzoQ5Ikb

我的第一篇帖子，分享一封 @NVIDIA 签署的、关于开放模型为何重要的信。

AI 将变革每个行业，赋能每家公司，并由每个国家共同建设。

开放模型能强化安全和网络安全，加速创新与普及，并实现主权自主。

世界既需要前沿闭源模型，也需要前沿开放模型。

https://t.co/AUKzoQ5Ikb

posts.text:
Just deployed a new chess engine; we're closing in on an estimated 1200 Elo. 

The goal is to get it to 2000+, while keeping the constraints:

1. One small finetuned LLM (no custom pretraining or architecture)
2. The model has to produce the moves with no chess engine assistance

If you relax these constraints, it gets much easier.

quotedTweet.text:
If you want to play my chess engine (WIP): https://t.co/4WJ9SYmr1o

It already seems to perform better than frontier models on chess.

It’s fine-tuned on 2M stockfish-labeled positions, then short GRPO RL pass.

Documentation/tutorial with all the experiments and annotated code.
quotedTweet.translationZh:
如果你想试玩我的国际象棋引擎（WIP）：https://t.co/4WJ9SYmr1o

它在国际象棋上的表现似乎已经优于前沿模型。

它基于 200 万个 stockfish 标注局面进行微调，随后进行了短轮 GRPO RL。

文档/教程包含所有实验和带注释的代码。

It can parse a variety of unlabeled line and bar charts with almost 100% accuracy. There are minor deltas with one or two datapoints, but the rest is pretty accurate machine-readable context that you can feed to downstream systems.

In contrast I also tried using Opus 5 itself to parse its own PDF. The chart accuracy is worse (20-30% reduction in ParseBench), and is a lot more expensive: it can cost anywhere from 8c to 33c+ per page depending on the thinking mode. 

If you're interested in giving LlamaParse a try, come check it out! https://t.co/XYZmx5TFz8

posts.text: This problem has gotten significantly worse. As Twitter and other social media have become primary channels for sharing research, academics are now expected to make the same ideas legible and appealing to both the general public (to go "viral") and senior scholars (to get the paper accepted). These audiences evaluate and reward almost opposite things, and there is little common ground between them. The result is truly the worst of both words (catchy and sales-y with no regard for prior work, and lots of jargon)

quotedTweet.text: Computer science people have developed an unintentional form of gatekeeping by virtue of being extremely bad at explaining/naming things, which results in simple concepts sounding far more complex than they are.
quotedTweet.translationZh: 计算机科学领域的人无意中形成了一种门槛，因为他们极其不擅长解释和命名事物，结果让简单概念听起来比实际复杂得多。

posts.translationZh: 这个问题已经严重恶化了。随着 Twitter 和其他社交媒体成为分享研究的主要渠道，学者如今被期望把同一套想法同时讲得能让大众看懂并感兴趣（以便“病毒式传播”），又能让资深学者认可（以便论文被接收）。这两类受众评判和奖励的东西几乎完全相反，彼此之间几乎没有共同点。结果真的是两头都最糟：既吸睛又像推销，完全不顾已有工作，还充满大量术语。

quotedTweet.text:
🔍 Introducing BackSearch.

LLMs are increasingly asked to predict the future, but a good backtest requires a snapshot of the internet at a point in time.

BackSearch allows LLMs to search the web as it was on a particular date. It’s great for:

🔮 Forecasting and prediction markets.
📈 Quantitative finance.
🌍 RL environments that simulate the world.
🥶 Freezing websearch for benchmark reproducibility

We’re releasing a narrow slice of our index to begin with, focused on the news domain for 2026. Based on feedback we’ll open up more of our index in subsequent releases.

👇 Try BackSearch out with the link below.
quotedTweet.translationZh:
🔍 隆重推出 BackSearch。

LLM 越来越多地被要求预测未来，但一次好的回测需要某个时间点的互联网快照。

BackSearch 让 LLM 能够搜索特定日期的网页。它非常适合：

🔮 预测和预测市场。
📈 量化金融。
🌍 模拟现实世界的 RL 环境。
🥶 冻结网页搜索，确保基准测试可复现。

我们一开始会发布索引中的一小部分，重点覆盖 2026 年的新闻领域。根据反馈，我们会在后续版本中开放更多索引。

posts.text: It's been great seeing the reception the Media Router has gotten. It's one of those products that just makes so much sense immediately. This is the first preference-optimized router for generative media. Enterprise teams already run large parts of their production pipelines in Runway, and as that work expands across more models, more teams and more budgets, Router gives them a single control layer for managing token spend across every media model they use. Instead of hand-picking a model for every request, you define what "best" means once, whether that's cost, quality, or latency, along with an allow list of model providers and Router automatically selects the right video, image or audio model.

quotedTweet.text:
